title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) PRISON STATISTICS - 1996 Kerala (224), Madhya Pradesh (197) and Maharashtra (174) reported higher number of female convicts in their Central Jails. Kerala & Karnataka also accommodated (96) & (56) number of female convicts respectively in the sub jails. Besides, Haryana accommodated (43) number of female convicts in Children jails.
